legend: TEN is an exciting push-your-luck and auction board game. Players may push their luck to draw more cards and use currency to buy additional cards in their attempt to build the longest number sequence in each color. Here let's consider a related problem to the game.

Given a sequence a1,a2,⋯,an$$$a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$$$ of length n$$$n$$$, we say its continuous subarray al,al+1,al+2,⋯,ar$$$a_l, a_{l + 1}, a_{l + 2}, \cdots, a_r$$$ is a rainbow subarray if ai+1−ai=1$$$a_{i + 1} - a_i = 1$$$ for all l≤i<r$$$l \le i  \lt  r$$$. Specifically, a subarray of length 1$$$1$$$ is always a rainbow subarray.

You can perform at most k$$$k$$$ operations. Each operation allows you to increase or decrease an element in the sequence by one. Calculate the maximum possible length of the longest rainbow subarray after performing the operations.
input: There are multiple test cases. The first line of the input contains an integer T$$$T$$$ indicating the number of test cases. For each test case:

The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n≤5×105$$$1 \le n \le 5 \times 10^5$$$, 0≤k≤1015$$$0 \le k \le 10^{15}$$$) indicating the length of the sequence and the maximum number of operations you can perform.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,⋯,an$$$a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤109$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$) indicating the sequence.
It's guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ of all test cases will not exceed 5×105$$$5 \times 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case output one line containing one integer indicating the maximum possible length of the longest rainbow subarray after performing at most k$$$k$$$ operations.
note: For the first sample test case, we can perform 4$$$4$$$ operations and change the sequence to {7,3,4,5,6,11,7}$$$\{7, 3, 4, 5, 6, 11, 7\}$$$. The longest rainbow subarray is {3,4,5,6}$$$\{3, 4, 5, 6\}$$$, so the answer is 4$$$4$$$.
For the second sample test case, we cannot perform any operation. The longest rainbow subarray is {3,4,5}$$$\{3, 4, 5\}$$$, so the answer is 3$$$3$$$.

For the third sample test case, we can perform 6$$$6$$$ operations and change the sequence to {−1,0,1,2,3}$$$\{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3\}$$$. The whole sequence is a rainbow subarray, so the answer is 5$$$5$$$.

legend.ai: TEN 是一款刺激的冒险竞价类棋盘游戏。玩家可以冒险抽取更多卡牌，也可以使用货币购买额外卡牌，试图在每种颜色中构建最长的数字序列。这里我们来考虑一个与该游戏相关的问题。

给定一个长度为 n$$$n$$$ 的序列 a1,a2,⋯,an$$$a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$$$，我们称其连续子数组 al,al+1,al+2,⋯,ar$$$a_l, a_{l + 1}, a_{l + 2}, \cdots, a_r$$$ 为彩虹子数组，当且仅当对于所有 l≤i<r$$$l \le i  \lt  r$$$，都有 ai+1−ai=1$$$a_{i + 1} - a_i = 1$$$。特别地，长度为 1$$$1$$$ 的子数组始终是彩虹子数组。
你最多可以执行 k$$$k$$$ 次操作。每次操作可以将序列中的一个元素增加或减少 1。请计算执行操作后，最长彩虹子数组的长度最大可能是多少。

input.ai: 本题有多组测试用例。输入的第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$，表示测试用例的数量。对于每组测试用例：
第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n≤5×105$$$1 \le n \le 5 \times 10^5$$$，0≤k≤1015$$$0 \le k \le 10^{15}$$$)，分别表示序列的长度和最多可以执行的操作次数。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,⋯,an$$$a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$$$(1≤ai≤109$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$)，表示该序列。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 5×105$$$5 \times 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一行，包含一个整数，表示至多进行 k$$$k$$$ 次操作后最长彩虹子数组的可能最大长度。

note.ai: 对于第二个样例测试用例，我们无法进行任何操作。最长的彩虹子数组是 {3,4,5}$$$\{3, 4, 5\}$$$，因此答案是 3$$$3$$$。
对于第三个样例测试用例，我们可以进行 6$$$6$$$ 次操作，将序列变为 {−1,0,1,2,3}$$$\{-1, 0, 1, 2, 3\}$$$。整个序列都是一个彩虹子数组，因此答案是 5$$$5$$$。
